title: Table metrics history system table is now generally available
body: The table metrics history system table (`system.storage.table_metrics_history`) is now generally available. Use it to track the daily storage size of your Unity Catalog managed tables, attribute storage costs, and find tables to clean up. See [Table metrics history system table reference](/aws/en/admin/system-tables/table-metrics-history).
